description: Road Safety Camera Network - Fixed Camera Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. All Victorian fixed digital road safety cameras are tested annually by an independent testing officer in accordance with the Road Safety (General) Regulations 2019. Once successfully tested, a certificate of compliance (referred to here as a ‘test certificate’) is issued for each camera, confirming it adheres to the Regulations and is operating correctly. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are Cameras, Cameras Save Lives, Digital Road Safety Camera, Fixed Camera, Locations. It offers 2 resource(s) in URL, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-03-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
